prediction: CACC feedforward will reduce speed-loss amplification relative to ACC at 50% penetration.
change_made: Enable delayed predecessor-acceleration feedforward; all else fixed.
interpretation: Use the measured amplification and delay differences; do not infer real-world crash reduction.

prediction: 100% equipment should yield a more coherent response than 50%, but tight automation may trade minimum gap against delay.
interpretation: Jointly inspect throughput, delay, amplification, and minimum gap.

prediction: 0.8-s delay plus 30% dropout will erase part of CACC's advantage because stale messages invoke ACC fallback.
interpretation: Fallback preserves bounded commands; performance may regress toward ACC.

prediction: Higher mainline/ramp demand will increase boundary and in-system delay and may expose residual queues.
change_made: Mainline 1500 to 1740 veh/h; ramp 360 to 480 veh/h.
interpretation: Count residual and overflow vehicles; do not report only completed trips.

prediction: A -3.5 m/s2 lead brake will increase hard braking and may reduce the relative benefit of low penetration.
change_made: Lead brake -2.5 to -3.5 m/s2 for 4 s.
interpretation: This is an operational stress test, not a crash-risk estimate.

prediction: Delay and amplification should be qualitatively stable at 0.05, 0.1 and 0.2 s.
interpretation: Large ranking changes would invalidate the main conclusion.

prediction: A one-step and stopping-distance supervisor will preserve the 2.0-m physical net-gap floor without invoking the final numerical guard.
change_made: Apply bounded immediate braking only when predicted clearance is exhausted; count supervisor and final-guard activations separately.
interpretation: All 12 final scenarios keep more than 2.0 m and record zero final-guard activations; supervisor use is verification evidence, not a real-world safety claim.

prediction: Holding the last exponential state across 20% missing intervals will increase forecast MAE.
change_made: Every fifth detector interval marked missing.
interpretation: Prediction was not supported: smoothing MAE fell from 1.820 to 1.618 because this deterministic removal pattern skipped noisy updates. Quality flags remain explicit; test more patterns before generalizing.
